Ask the Assistant in the car, or use the voice search of the app. Everything below can be combined in one sentence. A genre Play genre hardstyle Play uptempo hardcore Play drum and bass livesets An artist Play music by headhunterz Play artist brennan heart A label Play label art of creation A year Play hardstyle from 2021 Play headhunterz from 2020 An order Play random hardcore Play recent Play recently added Your favourites Play favourites Play favourites by headhunterz Play favourites from 2021 All of it at once Play random favourites from 2023 Play random uptempo hardcore from 2021 Later in the queue Play project one next Play dragonborn after this A name has to be one the library knows. What it cannot place is dropped and the rest of the request still plays; when it can place nothing at all, the ordinary search takes over and looks for the title.
